description: level=PostGlare; pass=downsample; state=ONE/ZERO LINEAR; cascade arm (E4==0 && E1): source = level A, vertex RGB = G+0xE6 raw (FH 0x30=48), UV row 1; other arms: source = capture, RGB=trunc(E6*0.95), row 0; reads=G+0x10 128x128 (FH); writes=EFB corner then copy; exclusive copy sites 0x8042F630 / 0x8042F7E8 (FH) / 0x8042F9C4

name: #27 ladder L5: level-B horizontal half
description: level=PostGlare; pass=separable tap sum; state=ONE/ONE LINEAR; 1+hB taps (FH hB=4 -> 5 taps: 0,+1,-1,+2,-2); reads=G+0x18; writes=G+0x18; -

name: #28 ladder L6: level-B vertical half
description: level=PostGlare; pass=separable tap sum; state=ONE/ONE; 1+vB taps (FH 5); reads=G+0x18; writes=G+0x18; -

name: #29 ladder L7: wipe
description: level=PostGlare; pass=clear; state=clear colour (0,0,0,0) IMAGE (Z untouched); reads=-; writes=EFB colour black; site 0x8042FA30

name: #30 ladder L8: merge B into A (E3==0 && E1 && E2)
description: level=PostGlare; pass=upsample merge; state=ONE/ONE LINEAR: draw A 1:1, draw B 64->128; reads=G+0x10 and G+0x18; writes=G+0x10 via copy then wipe; wipe (0,0,0,0) at 0x8042FF50 counted here

name: #31 ladder L9: composite level A
description: level=PostGlare; pass=upsample composite; state=ONE/ONE LINEAR; reads=G+0x10 (A + up(B)); writes=EFB colour (on black); E3!=0 path instead composites A (row 1) and B (row 2) separately

name: #32 ladder L10: add unblurred glare source
description: level=PostGlare; pass=composite; state=ONE/ONE LINEAR; reads=E+0x34 parent (glare source); writes=EFB colour; -

name: #33 PostGlare: scene add-back
description: level=PostGlare; pass=composite; state=ONE/ONE LINEAR; then restore the 8 saved states; reads=E+0x38 parent (scene save); writes=EFB colour = scene + glare source + bloom (8-bit saturating); ladder total BuildQuad calls 23/frame incl. this quad

name: #34 DrawBlur
description: level=PostGlare; pass=temporal + zoom composite; state=save 7 states; SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA; VERTEXALPHA; ZTEST 0 ZWRITE 0 FOG 0; FILTER NEAREST; vertex RGB 255 A=B+0x01; UV (off+0.5)/640..(off+w+0.5)/640; reads=B+0x74 parent 320x240 history (previous frame); writes=EFB colour; gate B+0x00 && B+0x01 && B+0x78

name: #35 EffectDrawShimmer
description: level=PostGlare; pass=refraction elements; state=per element; reads=bucket-6 elements; writes=-; atomic shimmer 0x80438168 never reached: E+0x4C is 0 in both dumps

name: #36 CameraRender + RenderUnits
description: level=Sprite3D; pass=world-space sprites; state=flags 0x20: ZTEST 1 ZWRITE 1 (scene Z still intact after glare/blur); reads=object sprites; writes=EFB; -

name: #37 CameraRenderClose
description: level=Last; pass=state close; state=leaves Sprite3D's ZTEST 1 ZWRITE 1 latched; reads=-; writes=-; -

name: #38 RenderAttach_Static
description: level=(group exec); pass=viewport restore; state=-; reads=-; writes=-; -

name: #39 SaveScreen
description: level=PostEffect; pass=history capture; state=B+0x78=0 first (unconditional); gate B+0 && B+1; stomp quad B+0x7C (0..320 x 0..240, UV 640 +0.5) and restore quad B+0xDC (0..640 x 0..480): SRC ONE DST ZERO; Z test/write INHERITED (LEQUAL write), filter inherited (measured NEAREST); z=0; reads=EFB (post-glare/blur/shimmer/Sprite3D frame); writes=E+0x34 parent 640x480; B+0x74 parent 320x240; EFB repainted; B+0x78=1; writes depth 0 over the screen when active

name: #40 DrawScreenColor
description: level=PostEffect; pass=tint / overlay / invert; state=C+0 multiply (C+3..5 != white): copy then ONE/ZERO redraw with vertex colour; C+0 overlay (C+0x0A!=0): untextured SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA; C+1 invert: untextured INVDESTCOLOR/ZERO; all ZTEST 0 ZWRITE 0 FOG 0 NEAREST; reads=EFB; C+0x10 (= E+0x34); writes=EFB colour; -

name: #41 CameraMatrix->Set2D
description: level=Sprite; pass=camera mode; state=-; reads=-; writes=camMgr+0x30..0x64; does NOT set an ortho projection (Im2D sets its own per primitive)

name: #42 CameraRender (0x418) + SpriteBack/SpriteMiddle/SpriteFront + RenderUnits
description: level=Sprite; pass=2D HUD; state=flags 0x418: SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA ZTEST 0 ZWRITE 0 alpha ALWAYS CULL NONE FILTER LINEAR fog off; TEV MODULATE; reads=HUD textures (C4/C8/RGB5A3...); writes=EFB colour; child order: Set2D, CameraRender, SpriteBack, SpriteMiddle, SpriteFront(+MessageTask/RenderUnits), then Sprite RenderUnits

name: #43 CameraRenderClose + CameraRender(0x418) + FadeDrawTask (+StageTitleTask when loading)
description: level=OnFade; pass=full-screen fade; state=ten 64x480 untextured tri-strips, vertex alpha; optional 109x135 badge quad; reads=fade state 0x80573E54; writes=EFB colour; fade darkens scene+HUD; stage title card and Gindows draw above it

name: #44 CameraRenderClose + CameraRender(0x418) + SaveMessageDrawTask
description: level=Gindows; pass=2D windows; state=flags 0x418; reads=window textures; writes=EFB colour; -

name: #45 CameraRenderClose + CameraMatrix->Reset2D
description: level=SpriteLast; pass=camera restore; state=-; reads=camMgr saved; writes=camera; -

name: #46 RenderStop
description: level=PostRender; pass=present (XFB copy); state=GXSetCopyFilter(aa 0, pattern 6s, vf ON, vfilter {8,8,10,12,10,8,8}) = 1/4,1/2,1/4 vertical deflicker; YScale 1.0; gamma 1.0; clear flag 0; GXFlush; GXCopyDisp(xfb); GXSetDrawSync(token); swap between 2 XFBs; throttles on VI queue; reads=EFB colour 640x480; writes=XFB 640x480 YUV (PAL60 interlaced EURGB60 DF); per frame totals FH: 9 GXCopyTex, 1 GXCopyDisp, 8 clears, 32 camera begins, 89 Im2D, 113 GXBegin, 176.3 GXCallDisplayList, 1061 GX primitives, 9021 triangles
